Subject: Sprint 1 Kickoff — rollcall, call rooms, and join links (timezone check)

Hi Rebecca —

Thanks again for confirming the contract signature. We want to lock in Sprint 1 kickoff logistics this week so your team can hit the integration milestones next month. Proposed items below: 

- Goal: Align owners, confirm call rooms, and share first-week meeting links and prework.
- Suggested cadence: 3 x short sessions during the first week (45m design sync, 60m integration walkthrough, 30m Q&A).
- Timezone note: your primary attendees are ET; please confirm if any APAC folks need alternative slots.

Can you confirm these windows will work for Atlas Health? If so we’ll send calendar invites with join links + a small agenda PDF and attendee roster.

Attached: Sprint1-Agenda.pdf (draft) — this is a lightweight agenda we can iterate.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hey Mateo —

Thanks — the plan looks good. Quick notes from our side: 

- Confirmed attendees (ET): Rebecca Chen (PM), Alex Park (SRE), Priya Kaur (Clinical Data).
- We have one APAC observer (Japan) who can join the recording only; no need for separate slot.
- Week of Aug 9 works. Preferred blocks: Tue/Wed mornings ET for the 45m and 60m sessions, Friday morning for the 30m Q&A.

Please include our procurement contact (procurement@atlashealth.com) on any billing/contract follow ups, but they don't need to join the kickoff.

Looking forward — please send invites.

Team —

Per Rebecca's confirmation, Atlas will attend Tue/Wed/Fri the week of Aug 9 (ET mornings). Action items: 

- Marissa: please own the integration walkthrough (60m). Bring the API sandbox link and a short demo plan.
- Soojin: take the design sync (45m) to validate prompt templates, data retention, and routing policies.
- Evelyn: handle the Q&A (30m), capture action items and follow-ups.

I've drafted a calendar plan and two call rooms so we don't run into capacity issues:
- Call Room A (Design & Walkthrough): https://meet.google.com/room-a-sprint1
- Call Room B (Integration deep-dive): https://meet.google.com/room-b-sprint1

I'll send invites after you confirm availability for those windows below: 
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–10:45 ET — Design sync (Call Room A)
- Wed Aug 11, 11:00–12:00 ET — Integration walkthrough (Call Room B)
- Fri Aug 13, 10:00–10:30 ET — Q&A + action items (Call Room A)

Attachments: Attendee-Roster.csv (CSV, 2KB) — please add any missing Atlas emails.

Thanks — confirm by EOD so I can finalize invites.

Mateo
